title: How to Be Rational About Rationality
coreMove: Ask whether a belief or action preserves the agent under exposure before calling it irrational.
sourcePressure: Rationality should be judged by survival and action under real constraints, not only by verbal coherence or formal elegance.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Turning the chapter into generic decision theory or anti-reason posturing.

sourceAnchors.name: How to Be Rational About Rationality
sourceAnchors.detail: The sidecar supports rationality as survival, action, and revealed preference rather than abstract theory alone.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The practical test is not whether the sentence sounds clean, but whether the behavior keeps people alive in the world that corrects them.

exampleSpecs.domain: parent keeping a taboo food rule because it prevents allergy confusion
